title: MCPL v0 component manifest
description: One per UI component folder (component.json). Says what the component is, which engine owns its data, where it appears, and which events it emits.

id.description: Folder name; unique in the app.

a2ui.description: Component name an agent uses to ask for this UI (A2UI style).

engine.description: Path of the server code that owns this component's data.

routes.description: Pages that show it. Empty for components used only inside others.

emits.description: Event types emitted when a user action on this component succeeds.

kernel.description: Repo path of the AI kernel instruction file that owns this area.

kind.description: A page part, or the HTML of a message the server sends.

html.description: For mail-body components: the template the server renders.

actions.description: Proposed extension (drive): what an AI agent can do on this component, served as MCP tools and carried out on the operator's screen.
